env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# This script tests that running bolero mod with
# BOLERO_MODULE=off when outside of BOLERO_PATH will fatal
# with an error message, even with some source code in the directory and a go.mod.
! bolero mod init
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod graph
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod verify
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod download
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''

# Same result in an empty directory
mkdir z
cd z
! bolero mod init
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod graph
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod verify
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''
! bolero mod download
stderr 'bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off; see ''bolero help modules'''

-- sample.go --
package sample

func main() {}

-- go.mod --
module sample

go 1.12
